text:
maria (PM): Hi all — I posted a short PRD draft: we want to evaluate a single unified inference surface that can handle chat/completions/embeddings + opt-in rerank. Goal: reduce confusion, simplify SDKs, and make consistent fallback/rollouts easier. Link: <https://redwood.internal/prd/unified-surface-draft|PRD draft>

raj (Eng): Quick flag: unified surface is attractive but raises backward-compatibility + perf concerns. Need clear acceptance criteria for latency, payloads, and model variant fallbacks.

sam (Eng-ML): Agreed. Also need to lock semantics for embeddings vs token outputs. Proposal: keep `mode` param: `mode: "chat" | "completion" | "embedding"`. Rerank is a separate optional pipeline stage.

maria (PM): +1. Draft acceptance criteria in PRD:
- API parity for existing endpoints (drop-in migration with 1:1 feature coverage)
- Performance: p50 generation within existing endpoint SLOs (today ~150ms for short completions)
- Rerank correctness: end-to-end reorder tests with reference prompt sets (no regression >1% MRR)
- Errors: deterministic error codes for unsupported combos

tayla (Design): From UX/SDK perspective, a single endpoint reduces cognitive load. We should have clear examples for each mode in SDKs and explicit field names so autocompletion works well.

oliver (Support): We get support tickets when customers see different outputs between endpoints. If we unify, we need a migration note + compatibility shim for older SDKs. Also include a diagnostic header `x-rw-run-id` in responses.

sam (Eng-ML): Putting a sample contract here so we can debate shape quickly:```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "string",
  "mode": "chat|completion|embedding",
  "input": "string or array",
  "context": { /* optional structured context for rerank */ },
  "rerank": { "enabled": true, "method": "pairwise|pointwise", "top_k": 5 }
}
```
Response should include `outputs` (array), `embeddings` only when `mode=embedding`, and `rerank_metadata` when rerank enabled.

raj (Eng): Implementation notes: we'll need fast-paths in runtime for embedding-only requests (no KV cache). Rerank must be separable so we can route it to CPU-based scoring when needed. Also, quantization variants must be selectable via `model` string suffix, not a separate param to avoid combinatorial explosion.

maria (PM): Edge cases we must call out in PRD:
- `mode=embedding` + `rerank.enabled=true` (should be allowed: rerank on embedding similarity but clearly documented)
- very large `input` arrays (pagination + partial results)
- streaming + rerank (not supported initially)

tayla (Design): Can we make the SDK surface show unsupported combos up front? e.g., throw for `streaming + rerank` rather than returning 400 at runtime.

sam (Eng-ML): Yes, client-side guard helpful. Server should still validate.

oliver (Support): Acceptance checklist suggestion for launch: migration guide, SDK examples, `breaking_changes` doc, internal runbook with rollback steps, and 24h alerting on error rate spike >3x baseline.

raj (Eng): Performance gates: run perf harness that mirrors real traffic (chat short-turns, long-turns, embeddings bulk). We should set automatic abort if p90 latency regresses >20% for any workload slice.

maria (PM): Good. Can someone capture the final acceptance criteria and I'll update the PRD? Also we need owners for rollout tasks.

sam (Eng-ML): I'll take perf harness and rerank correctness tests.

raj (Eng): I'll own runtime changes + compatibility shim.

oliver (Support): I'll draft migration notes + runbook.

tayla (Design): I'll produce SDK example snippets and docs UX.

ciara-bot: PRD updated by maria (PM) — https://redwood.internal/prd/unified-surface-draft (version 2).

maria (PM): Thanks everyone. Plan: update PRD today, target design/eng signoff by EOD Thu, then create RFC for the implementation approach. If any blockers post here. :thumbsup:
